description: This PHP file defines the entity class EmployeeWorkShift used in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It maps the EmployeeWorkShift object to the database table 'ohrm_employee_work_shift' and manages the relationships with Employee and WorkShift entities.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkShift
classes.description: Entity class representing the association between an Employee and a WorkShift in the database. It includes mappings for the work shift and employee reference and provides getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getWorkShift
methods.description: Returns the WorkShift associated with this EmployeeWorkShift.

methods.name: setWorkShift
methods.description: Sets the WorkShift associated with this EmployeeWorkShift.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this EmployeeWorkShift.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with this EmployeeWorkShift.
